cards.title: Format an imported user model
cards.explanation: Import the User type from your local models module without a runtime import. The model needs a string name property.

cards.title: Track retry attempts
cards.explanation: Keep a fixed retry limit and a mutable attempt counter.

cards.title: Validate an unknown string
cards.explanation: Narrow an unknown input before calling string methods.

cards.title: Build a greeting with a default
cards.explanation: Infer the default parameter type while documenting the returned string.

cards.title: Create a reusable prefix formatter
cards.explanation: Capture a prefix in a typed arrow function and pass it to map.

cards.title: Describe configurable notifications
cards.explanation: Keep a channel fixed through the typed reference and provide a retry default.

cards.title: Extend a stored record contract
cards.explanation: Reuse an identifier contract in a more specific user model.

cards.title: Name an application identifier
cards.explanation: Use aliases to document an application model; UserId remains structurally a string.

cards.title: Model a request outcome
cards.explanation: Use a discriminant to make successful and failed request states explicit.

cards.title: Check a record at an input boundary
cards.explanation: Check both the object and property type before claiming the Named contract.

cards.title: Read the first item without losing its type
cards.explanation: Preserve the element type and make an empty collection explicit in the return type.

cards.title: Filter and double even values
cards.explanation: Create a new array containing the doubled even values: 4 and 8.

cards.title: Return a labelled measurement pair
cards.explanation: Return two related values with named tuple positions and destructure them at the call site.

cards.title: Separate credentials from a public profile
cards.explanation: Omit a credential property from a new object and override a public field. This is a shallow projection.

cards.title: Sum positive values
cards.explanation: Skip nonpositive values while accumulating a total.

cards.title: Count repeated labels
cards.explanation: Increment a keyed count while defaulting absent entries to zero.

cards.title: Deduplicate task tags
cards.code:
const tags = ["bug", "urgent", "bug"];
const uniqueTags = [...new Set(tags)];
cards.explanation: Keep the first occurrence of each tag in insertion order.

cards.title: Load independent counts concurrently
cards.explanation: Start both independent operations before awaiting their combined results.

cards.title: Report a parsing failure safely
cards.explanation: Convert a caught value to a safe error message without assuming it is an Error.

cards.title: Encapsulate a counter
cards.explanation: Expose a method while keeping its backing state private to the TypeScript contract.

cards.title: Use a default for an absent profile name
cards.explanation: Read an optional field from an optional object and default only a nullish result.

cards.title: Describe a partial user update
cards.explanation: Allow updates to selected user fields while excluding the identifier from fresh patch literals.

cards.title: Read a property while preserving its type
cards.explanation: Constrain the key to real properties and retain the selected property type.

cards.title: Derive feature flags from configuration keys
cards.explanation: Turn configuration keys into a boolean feature-flag contract.

cards.title: Check a literal route table
cards.explanation: Check route values against a template literal pattern while retaining each literal path.

cards.title: Represent a task priority
cards.explanation: Use explicit string enum values for a task priority.

cards.title: React: count button clicks
cards.explanation: Use in a React .tsx file. The functional updater reads the latest state; React and its type definitions are required.

cards.title: React: restore the document title on cleanup
cards.explanation: Call this custom hook from a React component. It updates the browser title after commit and restores it on cleanup.

cards.title: Next.js: read a search query in a route
cards.explanation: Place in app/search/route.ts in a Next.js App Router project. It returns a JSON response for the q query parameter.

cards.title: Next.js: redirect a route to sign-in
cards.explanation: Place in an App Router route.ts. This is a route redirect, not authentication middleware or an authorization check.

cards.title: Vue: derive a filtered task list
cards.explanation: Use Vue refs for source values and computed for a derived list. In a component, these declarations normally belong in setup.

cards.title: Vue: watch a reactive search term
cards.explanation: Wait for the scheduled watcher, then stop it. Watchers created inside component setup are normally stopped when that component unmounts.

cards.title: Angular: derive a cart total
cards.explanation: Use writable signals for inputs and a computed signal for their total. Read signal values by calling them.

cards.title: Angular: inject a typed configuration value
cards.explanation: Create a provider and explicitly enter its injection context before calling inject. Destroy the manually created injector when finished.

cards.title: Express: validate and accept a JSON user
cards.explanation: Express 5 and Zod are required. Register the app with a server to accept requests; this example validates input before returning it.

cards.title: Express: send a safe error response
cards.explanation: Register four-argument error middleware after routes. Return a generic message and delegate when a response has already started.

cards.title: Zod: validate a signup payload
cards.explanation: Zod 4 validates and trims the runtime input before returning the inferred output type. Invalid input throws a ZodError.

cards.title: Zod: report a safe validation result
cards.explanation: Handle valid and invalid input without exceptions or exposing the complete error payload.

cards.title: Axios: fetch typed users with error handling
cards.explanation: Pass an absolute baseURL in Node. The response generic provides static typing only; validate untrusted data separately.

cards.title: Axios: create a user with cancellation
cards.explanation: Pass an AbortController signal so the caller can cancel the HTTP request. No request runs until this function is called.

cards.title: Lodash: group unique tasks by status
cards.explanation: Remove duplicate task IDs before grouping. Requires lodash and @types/lodash.

cards.title: Lodash: debounce a search callback
cards.explanation: Normally call search from an input handler. flush runs pending work immediately; cancel discards pending work during cleanup.

cards.title: date-fns: format a due date one week later
cards.explanation: Parse a local calendar date, add seven calendar days, and format it without mutating the original.

cards.title: date-fns: check a booking date range
cards.explanation: Test an inclusive interval and compute its span in calendar days rather than elapsed hours.

cards.title: RxJS: transform an observable sequence
cards.explanation: Collect a finite sequence into one array and unwrap its first emitted result.

cards.title: RxJS: switch to the latest search stream
cards.explanation: Replace the finite local inner stream with a cancellation-aware request observable in a real search UI.

cards.title: TanStack Query: load and display a todo count
cards.explanation: Use in .tsx with React and TanStack Query 5. The local loader is deterministic; replace it with a typed server loader in your app.

cards.title: TanStack Query: invalidate todos after a mutation
cards.explanation: Call this custom hook within a QueryClientProvider. A successful save marks matching todo queries stale and refetches active ones.

cards.title: Zustand: share a typed counter between components
cards.explanation: Use in a React .tsx file. Select count and action separately to avoid constructing an unstable result object.

cards.title: Zustand: subscribe to state outside React
cards.explanation: The vanilla store works without a component. Unsubscribe when the consumer no longer needs updates.

cards.title: Jest: check addition with a case table
cards.explanation: Run in a Jest test file with TypeScript transformation or after compiling it. Each row creates a separate test case.

cards.title: Jest: assert an asynchronous dependency call
cards.explanation: Await the asynchronous assertion and inspect the mock arguments with the Jest runner.

cards.title: Vitest: test valid and invalid schema input
cards.explanation: Run with Vitest and Zod 4 installed. Type-check separately because runtime test transformation does not enforce types.

cards.title: Vitest: mock a typed asynchronous loader
cards.explanation: Use the mock function inferred from its implementation and await its result assertion.

cards.title: Render a component with props and children
cards.explanation: Compose a panel with supplied content rather than calling the component as a normal function.

cards.title: Read an input from a change handler
cards.explanation: Keep input state controlled and type the extracted event handler in TSX.

cards.title: Count clicks with a functional state update
cards.explanation: Queue an update based on the previous count, with an optional typed label in TSX.

cards.title: Render keyed tasks with a conditional empty state
cards.explanation: Use fragments, expressions, stable keys and a visible empty state.

cards.title: Subscribe to window events with effect cleanup
cards.explanation: Subscribe once, remove the same handler on cleanup, and render the measured width.

cards.title: Abort a stale request when a component changes
cards.explanation: Handle HTTP errors and cancellation without allowing an old request to replace the new result.

cards.title: Focus an input through a DOM ref
cards.explanation: Guard the nullable element reference and specify its DOM type in TSX.

cards.title: Cancel a pending JSON request
cards.explanation: The caller owns cancellation and must handle result rejection, including AbortError.

cards.title: Read a UTF-8 file in Node
cards.explanation: Read a caller-provided local file; no hardcoded path or external service.

cards.title: Handle a rejected Express route in error middleware
cards.explanation: Keep private error details out of the response; Express 4 requires explicit async forwarding.

cards.title: Test a React interaction through its accessible role
cards.explanation: Use a DOM test environment (jsdom), React and Testing Library with Vitest.

cards.title: Extract validated result data with conditional infer
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. The runtime guard validates unknown input; the conditional type extracts only the successful return branch and cannot validate data by itself.

cards.title: Keep a union together when checking a batch
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. EachArray distributes into separate array types; WholeArray accepts a mixed array only when the entire union is allowed. The local assertion follows the generic constraint, not unvalidated input.

cards.title: Publish typed property-change events with unsubscribe
cards.explanation: Standalone module. This small emitter implements the nameChanged branch only; the finite EventName union documents available schema names. The returned function releases the listener.

cards.title: Build a finite typed route table
cards.explanation: Standalone module using satisfies (TypeScript 4.9+). Record requires every generated route. Runtime URLs from outside the program must be validated before using this typed lookup.

cards.title: Remap model keys into getter APIs
cards.explanation: Standalone module, key remapping requires TypeScript 4.1+. String keys become capitalized getter names; symbol and numeric keys are excluded. Functions read current values rather than storing snapshots.

cards.title: Remove internal keys from a public DTO
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. Remapping to never removes a key from the type, but does not erase runtime properties. The explicit projection omits the token from serialized data.

cards.title: Accept date parts or a timestamp through overloads
cards.explanation: Standalone module. Month is 1-based and parts use UTC; JavaScript normalizes out-of-range calendar parts. Two arguments are rejected by the overload contract, while invalid timestamps throw at runtime.

cards.title: Preserve scalar or list output shape
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. A scalar produces one label; a readonly list produces a fresh list. Empty lists remain empty and non-finite numbers fail rather than producing misleading display values.

cards.title: Assert and normalize an external user record
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. Only name is validated; extra keys are allowed. Check untrusted JSON after parsing, then catch TypeError at the caller boundary.

cards.title: Reject invalid configuration ports before use
cards.explanation: Standalone module. Undefined selects a default; null and numeric strings are rejected intentionally. Parse environment strings explicitly before this numeric validator.

cards.title: Render every loading result with exhaustive never
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. An empty successful result is ready with count 0, separate from pending or failure. The default branch also fails loudly for invalid runtime states.

cards.title: Handle a finite command union without silent fallbacks
cards.explanation: Standalone module. Zero additions preserve the state and reset returns 0. The never assignment forces new command variants to be implemented; non-finite amounts are rejected separately.

cards.title: Sort names without mutating readonly input
cards.explanation: Standalone module. Copies before sorting and uses deterministic code-unit ordering without locale assumptions. Empty input returns a fresh empty array; readonly does not freeze nested objects.

cards.title: Use readonly tuple bounds for a numeric clamp
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. Accepts a readonly two-element tuple; equal bounds are valid. Reversed or non-finite bounds fail at runtime. A plain number[] cannot guarantee exactly two positions.

cards.title: Read a constrained property from readonly records
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. keyof restricts the selected key and T[K] preserves its value type. Empty rows produce an empty array without widening the key contract.

cards.title: Accept a safe broader callback for a specific event
cards.explanation: Standalone strict module. A consumer of all animals can handle dogs. A dog-only callback cannot safely handle arbitrary animals; use function types rather than the method bivariance exception.

cards.title: Keep successful batch items and report rejected branches
cards.explanation: Standalone ES2022 module. Every rejection is observed and input order is retained within each group. Unlike Promise.all, one failure still allows successful results to be reported.

cards.title: Abort sibling work when an owned batch fails
cards.explanation: Standalone module. Each job must honor a pre-aborted signal and settle promptly after abort; uncooperative jobs can delay cleanup. The batch owns only its own controller, observes sibling failures, and preserves the original error.

cards.title: Validate a controlled name form with a reducer
cards.explanation: Standalone TSX, React 19.3.1. The form submits locally, reports blank names, trims successful values and supports reset. Saved holds the last successful value while name holds the editable draft.

cards.title: Undo a local draft with reducer history
cards.explanation: Standalone TSX, React 19.3.1. Repeated identical edits preserve state identity, empty history disables Undo, and edits are immutable. This teaching example keeps unbounded history; cap it for long sessions.

cards.title: Require a provider for typed theme context
cards.explanation: Standalone TSX, React 19.3.1. Wrap consumers in ThemeProvider. Each provider owns isolated state; the custom hook reports missing ownership instead of silently using a fake default.

cards.title: Clean up a context-provided status subscription
cards.explanation: Standalone TSX, React 19.3.1. The injected source must return an unsubscribe function. Switching sources resets to waiting and unsubscribes the old source; unmount releases the current subscription.

cards.title: Report Zod safeParse errors by field path
cards.explanation: Standalone module, Zod 4.6.7. Input stays unknown until validated; transformed names are trimmed. Object schemas strip unknown keys by default; issue codes/paths are more stable than message wording.

cards.title: Report a cross-field date-range validation issue
cards.explanation: Standalone module, Zod 4.6.7. Values are numeric instants in the same caller-selected unit. Equal endpoints are valid; a reversed range attaches a custom issue to end. No date-string or timezone parsing occurs.

cards.title: Validate an Express JSON request and return stable errors
cards.explanation: Standalone module, Express 5.3.0 and Zod 4.6.7. Unknown fields and blank names receive 422; malformed JSON gets 400 and oversized bodies 413. The caller owns listen/close; errors hide internal details.

cards.title: Map rejected Express routes into an owned error boundary
cards.explanation: Standalone module, Express 5.3.0 forwards rejected async handlers automatically. Inject a local loader and let the caller own server lifetime. Empty strings are valid values; undefined means missing and loader failure is retryable.

cards.title: Show TanStack Query pending, failure, retry and empty success
cards.explanation: Standalone TSX, TanStack Query 5.104.2 and React 19.3.1. Wrap with QueryClientProvider and clear the client on teardown. load must honor the supplied signal; use a separate query key per dataset. This example chooses explicit retries and an error view for any error.

cards.title: Keep cached query data visible when a refresh fails
cards.explanation: Standalone TSX, TanStack Query 5.104.2. Requires QueryClientProvider. A failed background refresh retains successful cached data and displays an alert. Empty arrays are successful data, distinct from undefined.
